title.fr: Oscillations électriques libres non amorties (circuit LC)

sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic (L, C, switch) with ideal LC oscillator;
polyline u_C(t) = U₀·cos(ω₀t) with ω₀ = 1/√(LC), T₀ = 2π√(LC).
Student sweeps L, C; HUD reads T₀ and total energy E_total = ½C·U₀²
conserved. Experiment: 3 seeded target T₀; student picks (L, C)
pairs. Evaluate: live curve hidden; only target period shown;
student submits (L, C) blind. Wrinkle: closed form used; energy
conservation gauge is a secondary insight.
